When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Municipal inclusion efforts collide with federal enforcement realities, generating friction rather than cohesion.

The Unavoidable Truth: Local police departments are adjusting qualification rules to fill recruitment gaps.

The Unavoidable Lie: This municipal ordinance neutralizes federal immigration enforcement tensions.
